claims: Artemis II launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission used the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket to propel the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission carried four astronauts on a lunar flyby mission.
The Artemis II crew consisted of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The goal of the Artemis II mission was the first crewed flight around the Moon since 1972.
Artemis II was the first crewed mission of the Artemis program.
The Artemis program is designed to test the systems necessary for future deep space exploration.
